summary: The Neverhood entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: The Neverhood
entries.definitive_edition: Original Windows version using owned data through ScummVM

emulation.notes: Use owned game data. Windows 95 VM/hardware only for exact-runtime comparison.
emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Original Windows data interpreted by ScummVM or period Windows hardware

primary.platform: Windows PC / ScummVM with owned data
primary.version: Original Windows CD data through current ScummVM support
primary.why: The Neverhood has no normal current storefront route. The practical archive path is the original Windows CD data with ScummVM compatibility, which preserves the claymation adventure while avoiding fragile Windows 95 setup.
primary.how_to_play: Use owned original Windows data in ScummVM. Record ScummVM version, data-file provenance, language/region, display scaling, music/audio behavior, puzzle progress, hint/walkthrough use, and whether original Windows 95 or the Japanese PlayStation port was compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if preserving exact period PC behavior matters.
secondary.why: ScummVM is the easier capture route, but original Windows hardware or a VM better preserves the historical artifact.
It is a regional console branch, not the main English PC route.

entries.remaster_caveats: No current official remaster/storefront route is sourced; record data provenance and ScummVM version.
